name: CSO_OCE_ASSET_REFS
description: This table stores Content Management asset references.

columns.name: ASSET_REF_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: This attribute stored the asset Id of Content Management.

columns.name: CONTENT_TEXT_ID
columns.description: This is the article's version that asset belongs to. Foreign key that references cso_content_text (RECORD_ID).

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: This attribute holds the document Id from cso_content_text.documentId.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the value of Knowledge article locale Id.

columns.name: ANSWER_ID
columns.description: This is the value of Knowledge article answer Id.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: This is the document attribute name defined in the content type of the document, value in cso_schema_attribute.system_value.

columns.name: USER_GROUPS
columns.description: This attribute stores a list of user group reference keys, separated by comma.

columns.name: MIGRATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this row Asset has been migrated to UCM.

columns.name: FILE_METADATA_ID
columns.description: Links the asset ID to new file ID during migration.
